title: G4 failed a correct panel-only verification round for having no blind review

found.context: Live runs of the untested 0.5.0 paths on the demo project, 2026-11-03: panel round 2

observed_failure: review_panel.md section 8 runs round 2 as a panel-only verification re-review. g4_check.py looked for the blind reviewer's diagnostics.json in that round, found none, and failed with G4_NO_REVIEW, so a project following the documented process could never pass G4 after round 2.
expected_behavior: For a verification round, G4 takes the blind review, its packet and its dispositions from the round it verifies (previous_round), and checks the panel against its own round's packet.

resolution.summary: g4_check.py resolves the reader's round from the verification decision
